Modified HAL_RCC_OscConfig to remove hardware-dependent operations for emulation:
1. Removed all while loops that wait for hardware flags (HSE, HSI, LSI, LSE, PLL ready flags)
2. Removed hardware register accesses (RCC->PLLCFGR, PWR->CR1, etc.)
3. Removed timeout checking logic that depends on HAL_GetTick()
4. Preserved parameter validation and structure checking
5. Returns HAL_OK to indicate successful initialization in emulation
6. Maintains the function signature and basic structure for compatibility
This is classified as an INIT type function with LOOP elements that needed to be skipped.
